hero.name: William Nascimento
hero.summary: Nearly 14 years of experience in software engineering, including around 8 years in banking technology, fraud prevention, payments and identity. I design and lead the development of resilient backend platforms for regulated, high-stakes environments.

about.title: A brief introduction
paragraphs: I'm a technology professional with close to 14 years of experience in software engineering and technical leadership. Over the last eight years, I've focused on the financial sector — fraud prevention, security, identity, authentication, payments and mission-critical banking systems.
I've worked at two of Brazil's largest financial institutions, Itaú Unibanco and Bradesco, contributing to initiatives with meaningful impact on customers, operations and security.

My experience goes beyond writing code. I've worked on solution architecture, integrations, technical design, team leadership, communication with business and vendor stakeholders, delivery tracking, incident resolution and decision-making in complex, high-stakes environments.
I've also worked with large-scale platforms — in some of these roles, with systems processing around 8,000 transactions per second.
I'm currently based in Dublin, Ireland, strengthening my English, broadening my international experience and preparing for the next stage of my career.
